question: Which city is home to the cricket ground, Wankhede Stadium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Wankhede Stadium** is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, and is one of India’s most iconic cricket venues.
 
• It was established in **1974** and has hosted numerous international matches, including the 2011 ICC Cricket World Cup Final.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of approximately **33,000 spectators**.
 
• It is the home ground of the **Indian Premier League (IPL) team Mumbai Indians** and the Mumbai cricket team.
 
• Renovated in 2010, the stadium is equipped with modern facilities and offers panoramic views of the Arabian Sea.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of the Wankhede Stadium:**

 
 
• The stadium was constructed after disputes between the Cricket Club of India (CCI) and the Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) over Brabourne Stadium.
 
• It was named after **Sheshrao Wankhede**, a politician and former president of the MCA.
 
 
 
• **Notable Matches:**
 
 
• The stadium hosted the historic **2011 ICC Cricket World Cup Final**, where India defeated Sri Lanka to win the trophy.
 
• It has also hosted Test matches, ODIs, and T20Is featuring some of the world’s best cricketers.
 
 
 
• **Renovation:**
 
 
• The stadium underwent extensive renovation in **2010** to prepare for the 2011 Cricket World Cup.
 
• Upgrades included new seating arrangements, better drainage facilities, and improved player amenities.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai's Sporting Legacy:**
 
 
• Mumbai is considered the cradle of Indian cricket, having produced legendary players such as **Sachin Tendulkar, Sunil Gavaskar, and Rohit Sharma**.
 
• The city has a rich cricketing heritage, with Wankhede Stadium playing a central role in its history.
